title: Blocking Block Formation: Evidence from Private Loan Contracts
eligible_reason: No two-way fixed-effects design. The analysis is a pooled cross-section of syndicated loan packages (1995-2015) without borrower fixed effects: probit mbr <treatment> $RHS3/$RHS5, vce(cluster gvkey) and reg cap <treatment> $RHS3/$RHS5, vce(cluster gvkey), where RHS3/RHS5 contain time-varying firm and loan controls plus loan-year (i.year_loan) and Fama-French-12 industry dummies. The two quasi-experimental regressors are treated_ma (borrower had an institutional-investor M&A before the loan effective date) and decimal (loan after exchange decimalization: NYSE/AMEX Jan 2001, NASDAQ Apr 2001, with year dummies for 2001-2002 omitted). Neither is estimated with unit fixed effects, the mbr outcomes use probit, and all columns include time-varying controls; the Tobin's Q and blockholder-change regressions (Tables 6-7) are areg ... absorb(year_loan) first-difference regressions with lagged dependent variables. The package also ships only synthetic data.
design_notes: Loan-package level data merging DealScan, Compustat, CRSP, hand-collected change-in-control/ownership-cap clauses. Code: 1.5_code_tables.do (Stata), 1.1-1.2 SAS builds. Table 3: probit mbr / reg cap on treated_ma, ln_hhi5, LOG_HHI_DIFF, sh1_23 with $RHS3 (firm controls + i.year_loan + i.ff12ind) or $RHS5 (adds loan controls, loan purpose/type). Table 4: decimal with $RHS3dec/$RHS5dec (year dummies y2-y6, y9-y21). Table 6: pricing regressions via 1.6_prog_pricingreg.ado (Heckman-type IMR). Table 7: areg d21_tobinsq / d22_block13_num1 on n2b/n2m/ch_up with entropy-balance pweights, absorb(year_loan).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: treated_ma switches on at firm-specific institutional-M&A dates and decimal has two exchange-specific dates, but no specification includes unit fixed effects.
data_files_note: readme.docx: '2.2_final_data_synthetic.dta: Synthetic data created for the replication package purposes that is used to generate tables'; tables in 4.1_tables_synthetic_data are generated from it. Logs from the real data are included.
software_notes: Stata 17 for analysis (probit, reg, areg, estout); SAS 9.4 for data construction.
priority_note: Not eligible (no unit FE, probit, controls) and synthetic data.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). The frame lists year 2019 for this DOI, which looks inconsistent with the 2023 manuscript number; verify publication year when the article page is checked. Add to data/synthetic_packages.txt if not already listed.
